entries.clue: Dark diver perched on a harbour post, both wings held wide open to dry
Enclosed yard inside the outer wall, holding stables, forge and storehouses
Grey statue in the shallows that waits, stabs, and swallows the fish whole
Shelved stack against the wall, sagging under paperbacks never reread
Narrow side door for slipping a messenger out while the main gates stayed barred
Upper chamber over the great hall where the lord's family withdrew from the smoke
Three-seater that swallows remote controls and loose change
Taps, a plughole, and a growing heap of washing-up
Pied car-park sprinter whose rear end never once stops bobbing up and down
Great tower at the heart of a stronghold, the last refuge once the walls were lost
